name: Release process
description: How we publish a new version
content: Bump the version in package.json, update CHANGELOG.md, then tag vX.Y.Z and push the tag. The Release OASIS workflow builds the tarball and uploads assets.

name: Test runner
description: Use node --test, not jest
content: The project uses the built-in node:test runner with node:assert/strict. Run npm test. Jest and vitest are not installed; do not add them.

name: Package manager
description: Always use pnpm in the web workspace
content: The apps/web folder uses pnpm with a lockfile. Running npm install there creates a second lockfile and breaks CI.

name: Postgres connection pool
description: Pool size is capped at 10 per worker
content: PG_POOL_MAX is 10. Larger pools exhausted the managed database's connection limit during the March outage.

name: Code style
description: Semicolons, single quotes, two-space indent
content: Match the existing style: semicolons, single quotes, 2-space indentation. oxlint enforces most of it with --deny-warnings.

name: Commit messages
description: Imperative subject under 72 characters
content: Write commit subjects in the imperative mood, under 72 characters, no trailing period. Explain why in the body.

name: User timezone
description: The user is in Dhaka, UTC+6
content: Schedule times and dates in Asia/Dhaka (UTC+06:00) unless the user says otherwise.

name: No emojis
description: The user dislikes emojis in output
content: Never add emojis to commit messages, docs or replies.

name: Auth token storage
description: Access tokens live in the OS keychain
content: Store API keys with the keychain helper (src/keychain.mjs). Never write them to config.json or logs. Fall back to a 0600 file only when no keychain exists.

name: Provider rate limits
description: Free gateways allow about 20 requests a minute
content: Pollinations and LLM7 throttle at roughly 20 requests per minute; back off on 429 using the Retry-After header.

name: CI Node versions
description: CI runs Node 20, 22 and 24
content: The Quality checks workflow tests on Node 20, 22 and 24 on Linux, plus Node 22 on macOS and Windows.

name: Web app port
description: oasis web listens on 3917 by default
content: Default port is 3917 on 127.0.0.1. Use --host 0.0.0.0 only with an access key for phones on the same network.

name: Flaky browser test
description: The approval card test needs a longer timeout on CI
content: browser-e2e approval-card step flakes on slow macOS runners; the wait was raised to 15 seconds. Do not lower it.

name: Database migrations
description: Use drizzle-kit for schema changes
content: Generate migrations with drizzle-kit generate and commit the SQL file. Never edit an applied migration; add a new one.

name: Translations
description: UI strings go through t() with keys in locales/en.json
content: Every user-facing string uses t('key'). Add the English text to locales/en.json; translators handle the rest.

name: Docker image
description: Production image is built from the distroless Dockerfile
content: Use Dockerfile.distroless for production. The dev Dockerfile includes a shell and build tools and must not ship.

name: Error helper
description: API routes return errors through httpError()
content: Throw httpError(status, message) in route handlers; the middleware turns it into JSON with a request id. Do not res.status().json() directly.

name: Output token cap
description: maxOutputTokens defaults to 16000
content: The maxOutputTokens setting defaults to 16000; models with smaller limits are clamped by the provider catalog.

name: Windows path bug
description: path.join breaks file URLs on Windows
content: Use fileURLToPath and pathToFileURL instead of string concatenation; a backslash in a file URL broke skill loading on Windows.

name: Code reviewer
description: Rahim reviews all security changes
content: Ask Rahim to review anything touching permissions, sandboxing or secret redaction before merging.

name: Staging deploys
description: Merges to main deploy to staging automatically
content: Every merge to main deploys to staging.example.com within ten minutes. Production deploys are manual from the Actions tab.

name: Logging
description: Use the structured logger, not console.log
content: Import log from src/log.mjs; it writes JSON lines with a level and redacts secrets. console.log output is stripped in production.

name: Startup time
description: oasis --version must stay under 100 ms
content: The fast path in src/oasis.mjs avoids loading the agent graph. Measure with scripts/measure-startup.mjs before adding a top-level import to cli.mjs.

name: Linux sandbox
description: bubblewrap is the Linux sandbox backend
content: On Linux the OS sandbox uses bwrap (bubblewrap). Network is blocked unless sandbox.network is allowed. macOS uses sandbox-exec.

name: Feature flags
description: Flags are read from OASIS_FLAG_* environment variables
content: New experimental behavior goes behind an OASIS_FLAG_NAME environment variable that defaults off, and is documented in CONFIGURATION.md.

name: Python tooling
description: Use uv for the evals harness
content: The Python harness under evals/harbor uses uv. Run uv sync then uv run pytest. Do not pip install globally.

name: License headers
description: No per-file license headers
content: The repository is Apache-2.0 via the LICENSE file. Do not add license comment headers to new source files.

name: README screenshots
description: Screenshots come from the browser e2e run
content: Regenerate assets/screenshots with OASIS_SCREENSHOT_DIR=/tmp/e2e node .github/scripts/browser-e2e.mjs, then copy the dark-theme PNGs.

name: Repo map cache
description: The repo map is cached per repository
content: Repo maps are cached under the config directory cache/repo-map keyed by repository hash and invalidated when git HEAD changes.

name: Incident contact
description: Page the on-call engineer through PagerDuty
content: For production incidents page the on-call rotation in PagerDuty; do not DM individuals at night.
